hooks.name: Git Safety (Spot)
hooks.description: Prevent destructive git operations in spot sessions

action.command: bash -c 'read -t 1 INPUT 2>/dev/null; CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.command" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "(git\s+push\s+--force|git\s+reset\s+--hard)"; then echo "❌ Destructive git command blocked in spot mode" >&2; exit 1; fi; exit 0'
